evals.name: convert-real-html-prototype
evals.prompt: I've got a prototype at /Users/work/Documents/Projects/pension-calculator — it's the Government pension calculator, plain HTML with its own styles.css. Can you bring it onto the GovBB design system? Start with index.html and calculate.html. Don't touch my working copy, put the converted files somewhere separate and tell me what you changed.
evals.expected_output: An inventory of the prototype's UI mapped to real GovBB components before any conversion; converted index.html and calculate.html written to a separate location using only real govbb- classes; the prototype's parallel token system (--spacing-xs, --color-grey-00, --font-size-body) mapped onto --govbb-* tokens; recognition that styles.css locally redefines .govbb-table and that this is restyling component internals; an honest gap list.
assertions: Every govbb- class in the converted output resolves to a selector in packages/frontend/dist/govbb.css
No --govbb- custom property is used that is not defined in packages/frontend/dist/govbb.css
An inventory mapping each prototype element to a named real component, pattern or template is shown before any file is converted
The prototype's own custom properties (--spacing-xs, --color-grey-00, --font-size-body) are replaced by --govbb-* tokens and do not survive in the converted output
Semantic tokens are used in place of literal colours, spacing values and font sizes, and any literal with no matching token is recorded rather than snapped to the nearest one
The local redefinition of .govbb-table in styles.css is identified as restyling component internals and is not carried into the converted CSS
The converted files are written outside /Users/work/Documents/Projects/pension-calculator and the original files are left unmodified
The report contains a gap list naming what could not be converted, with a route for each item, rather than omitting those elements silently

evals.name: build-new-react-with-traps
evals.prompt: starting a new react app for a business licence renewal service for gov.bb. i need a landing page and then the renewal form. for the form i want tabs so people can jump between the 3 sections, a modal that pops up to confirm before they submit, and a toggle switch for the 'email me updates' option. can you scaffold this with the govbb design system?
evals.expected_output: Uses @govtech-bb/react wrappers and imports the stylesheet once at the app root; does NOT invent govbb-tabs, govbb-modal or govbb-toggle; explains that tabs/modal are deliberately absent and routes to one-thing-per-page / separate pages, and that a toggle should be a Checkbox; suggests the landing and single-question-page templates; does not call initAll() in React.
assertions: No govbb-tabs, govbb-modal or govbb-toggle class, component or CSS file appears anywhere in the output
Every govbb- class and --govbb- token in the output resolves in packages/frontend/dist/govbb.css
Components are imported from @govtech-bb/react and @govtech-bb/frontend/css is imported exactly once, at the app root
initAll() is not called anywhere in the React code
The reply states that tabs and a modal do not exist in the design system and proposes separate pages following one thing per page instead
The 'email me updates' control is built as the existing Checkbox rather than as a new switch component
The scaffold is based on named templates or patterns fetched from the design system site, not assembled from scratch
The three requested interfaces the system does not provide are recorded as gaps routed to the design team rather than quietly substituted

evals.name: review-planted-violations
evals.prompt: Can you review evals/design-system-compliance/fixtures/review-me.html and tell me whether it's design-system compliant? Just a review please, don't rewrite the file.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the invented classes (govbb-card, govbb-alert, govbb-badge) and the invented token (--govbb-color-primary); flags the .govbb-button override as restyling component internals; catches the missing data-govbb-module + initAll() wiring on header and file upload; flags hardcoded #00267f/16px/1.25rem and the direct use of the primitive --govbb-blue-100; notes the unassociated hint. Does not rewrite the file, and does not invent violations that are not present.
assertions: Reports .govbb-card as an invented class with no such component
Reports .govbb-alert as an invented class and names Status banner as the real answer
Reports .govbb-badge as an invented class with no such component
Reports --govbb-color-primary as an invented token and names --govbb-color-brand instead
Flags the .govbb-button rule in the page's own CSS as restyling component internals
Flags the header as missing its data-govbb-module attribute and the initAll() call
Flags the file upload as missing the same module wiring
Flags the hardcoded #00267f, 16px and 1.25rem values as needing tokens
Flags --govbb-blue-100 as a primitive used directly where a semantic token is meant
Flags the hint as not associated with its input via aria-describedby
The class and token names in the review are checked against the design system site or packages/frontend/dist/govbb.css rather than asserted from memory
review-me.html is left byte-for-byte unmodified and no rewritten version is produced
No violation is reported that is not one of the ten planted in the fixture
